entry.title: Entry #1808 in The New York Times Company v. Microsoft Corporation, 1:23-cv-11195
entry.summary: ORDER: On October 28, 2026, attorney Brian L. Frye filed a proposed letter motion to file an amicus brief. (Dkt. No. 2282.) However, the filing does not request leave to file the amicus brief, in violation of the Court's Order on amicus filings. (Dkt. No. 1663.) IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that the Clerk of Court is directed to dismiss the motion. Mr. Frye may refile if he chooses. (Signed by Judge Sidney H.
